name: Frozen account with insufficient funds
description: Beneficiary account is FROZEN and the transaction failed with INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS. The agent should recommend RETRY_AFTER_UPDATE with correction suggestions (unfreeze/credit the account before retrying).

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: Verification shows the beneficiary account DE89370400440532013000 is currently FROZEN, which explains the INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS rejection - a frozen account cannot accept credits until it is released. The payment details themselves are valid, so the transaction can be retried once the account is unfrozen.
correction_suggestions: Contact the beneficiary bank to unfreeze account DE89370400440532013000 before resubmitting the payment.
Confirm the account status is ACTIVE again after the freeze is lifted.

api_requests.notes: Suggestions should reference the frozen account state and/or funding requirement.
